summary.text: Bill Hixon is a Republican state representative from Edgefield and North Augusta who has represented South Carolina House District 83 since 2011 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Hixon is a real estate and insurance business owner and chairs the House Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hixon is president and owner of Hixon Realty Co. and president of Hixon Insurance Agency Inc., and he received the Accredited Land Consultant designation in 2010.
His legislative biography also lists him as a volunteer fireman in North Augusta since 1973, a State Constable, and a past president of the North Augusta Board of Realtors.
Hixon has served in the House since 2011.
The Republican primary on June 9, 2026, was canceled, and Hixon faces Democrat Jason Payne in the November 3 general election.
